compiled_state.description:
## Context
Nava is in active discovery with Washington State (ACES ~30yr mainframe, 12M lines COBOL; DSHS IE&E; seven-agency HHS Coalition; WaTech CIO Bill Kehoe). Owner-approved deliverable: `docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md` — EXACTLY 10 discovery questions that (a) improve our ability to deliver a successful modernization plan, (b) reduce the risks that cause modernization projects to fail, and (c) give the client confidence/evidence to succeed. Each question carries: failure mode de-risked (corpus citations), the specific WA record gap, the concrete artifact to request, and how each plausible answer changes decision-model inputs (pain/coupling/change/write-back/contract pins — app/src/lib/decision/, infra-demo/api/generator/core.mjs).

## Plan
Three child tasks, sequenced: (1) assemble the two evidence bases (WA knowns/unknowns from docs/references/washington + samples/washington + evaluations/virtual-cio/evaluation-wa-report; failure corpus from GA/VT/NY/AZ references + cross-state persona findings) into the deliverable skeleton; (2) distill a 12–15-row failure-mode taxonomy and a WA gap matrix (evidenced / assumed-in-memo / unknown); (3) draft ~25 candidates, score, select 10, validate against the Kehoe persona on Bedrock (harness pattern: evaluations/virtual-cio/evaluation-wa-report/run-eval.mjs), revise, keep raw artifacts in evaluations/virtual-cio/wa-discovery-questions-review/. Docs+evaluations only; no app code. Lands on branch feat/wa-discovery-questions via PR; orchestrator merges.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Deliverable exists with exactly 10 questions: `test "$(grep -c '^### Q' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md)" -eq 10`
- [ ] Failure-mode taxonomy section present with >=12 numbered failure modes: `test "$(grep -c '^| F' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md)" -ge 12`
- [ ] Gap matrix present crossing WA against failure modes: `grep -q '## Appendix A — WA gap matrix' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md`
- [ ] Persona-validation artifacts committed (raw request+response + findings): `test -f evaluations/virtual-cio/wa-discovery-questions-review/findings.md && ls evaluations/virtual-cio/wa-discovery-questions-review/raw/*response*.json`
- [ ] Every question names the failure mode, the WA gap, and the artifact to request: `test "$(grep -c '^- \*\*De-risks' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md)" -eq 10 && test "$(grep -c '^- \*\*Why WA' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md)" -eq 10 && test "$(grep -c '^- \*\*Ask for' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md)" -eq 10`

## Testing
Deterministic grep/test commands above run from repo root on branch feat/wa-discovery-questions. Persona validation is a committed-artifact check (raw Bedrock request/response JSON). Docs-only change: no app build/test needed; PR CI (incl. rebar code-review gate) is the integration check — PR link recorded as a [non-codebase] comment.
